title: FAIRChem v2 UMA for Multidomain Atomistic Simulation across Molecules, Catalysts, Materials, Vibrations, and Molecular Dynamics
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: In this tutorial, we explore FAIRChem v2 and the UMA universal machine-learning interatomic potential as a unified framework for atomistic simulation across molecular chemistry, ca...
body: The Fairchem team has released Fairchem V2, featuring the Unified Machine Learning Force Field (UMA) for high-accuracy atomistic simulations. Designed to scale across diverse domains including molecules, catalysts, and solid-state materials, V2 achieves state-of-the-art energy and force prediction accuracy. This open-source release aims to accelerate materials discovery and molecular dynamics workflows. Researchers can now simulate complex atomic structures with significantly reduced computational requirements, making quantum-level accuracy accessible to larger scientific teams working on sustainable energy and chemical synthesis solutions. This marks a major step forward for open scientific research.
